package.name: terrain_traversability
package.description:
Real-time terrain traversability assessment node. Fuses RPLidar A1 (2D scan) and ICM-20948 IMU (via Madgwick AHRS) to estimate slope risk, vibration roughness, and obstacle proximity. Publishes composite risk score and local OccupancyGrid costmap.
References: Papadakis (2013) Engineering Applications of AI 26(8):1373-1397 Thrun et al. (2006) Journal of Field Robotics 23(9):661-692 Brooks and Iagnemma (2005) IEEE Trans. Robotics 21(6):1185-1191
